WITH per_order_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE ordersmark IS NOT NULL 
    AND fillcount IS NOT NULL 
    AND fillcount > 0
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
benchmark1_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as benchmark1 FROM per_order_avg
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    poa.ordersmark,
    poa.avg_fill,
    poa.avg_fill - b1.benchmark1 as first_excess
  FROM per_order_avg poa, benchmark1_calc b1
  WHERE poa.avg_fill > b1.benchmark1
),
benchmark2_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as benchmark2 FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    ff.ordersmark,
    ff.avg_fill,
    ff.first_excess,
    ff.avg_fill - b2.benchmark2 as second_excess
  FROM first_filter ff, benchmark2_calc b2
  WHERE ff.avg_fill > b2.benchmark2
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_fill) as final_avg_fill,
  AVG(first_excess) as avg_first_excess,
  AVG(second_excess) as avg_second_excess
FROM second_filter    -- returns the three requested summary values: average per-order fill, average first excess, and average second excess
